verdict.rationale: Preparing and filing entity annual reports or state compliance filings is a registered-agent / business-compliance service, which falls outside Docusign's e-signature and agreement-management category. The pack's AI features (MCP-triggered workflow actions, flagging non-compliant contract clauses) concern agreements. Nothing shows Docusign preparing or submitting annual reports or regulatory filings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
